attack_plan.narrative: Recent sightings of Putin in the Stockholm Archipelago have raised eyebrows among geopolitical analysts. The proximity of this area to NATO member states and its strategic importance have led many to speculate about a potential shift in Russia’s regional dynamics. There has been a notable absence of Putin from public appearances since the 2014 Winter Olympics in Sochi. This extended period of silence has led some to speculate about a possible internal power struggle within the Kremlin. Sources within the Kremlin and Russian military circles have provided conflicting reports regarding Putin’s current status. Some insiders claim he is still in power, while others suggest he may be under house arrest or even in hiding due to a palace coup. The combination of Putin’s absence from public appearances and the lack of official statements from the Kremlin raises significant questions about his current situation. The recent sightings in the Stockholm Archipelago, combined with the absence of any official confirmation, have fueled speculation about a potential palace coup.
